Destination Mastery

Mastery

HintReplays, discoveries, guided opportunities, and varied challenge methods all feed the same destination progression.
WhereRaise this destination's Mastery to rank 1; the Challenges tab supplies the XP needed for every gated reward.
Full detailComplete high-value challenges first, then use unclaimed discoveries and simple feats to fill the remaining XP. Reach rank 1 and verify every reward in the Career mastery panel. Unlock schedule: At rank 1, claim Challenge as a Tactical Turtleneck reward; At rank 1, claim Mission Story as a Lockpick reward; At rank 1, claim Challenge as a Tactical Turtleneck with Gloves reward.

Destination Mastery

Mastery

HintReplays, discoveries, guided opportunities, and varied challenge methods all feed the same destination progression.
WhereRaise this destination's Mastery to rank 20; the Challenges tab supplies the XP needed for every gated reward.

Destination Mastery

Mastery

HintReplays, discoveries, guided opportunities, and varied challenge methods all feed the same destination progression.
WhereRaise this destination's Mastery to rank 20; the Challenges tab supplies the XP needed for every gated reward.
Full detailComplete high-value challenges first, then use unclaimed discoveries and simple feats to fill the remaining XP. Reach rank 20 and verify every reward in the Career mastery panel. Unlock schedule: At rank 1, claim Tobias Rieper's Suite as a Starting Location reward; At rank 2, claim Shuriken as a Melee reward; At rank 3, claim Mountain Path as a Agency Pickup reward; At rank 4, claim Staff Wardrobe as a Hidden Stash reward; At rank 5, claim Custom 5mm as a Pistol reward; At rank 6, claim Spa as a Starting Location reward; At rank 7, claim Masamune as a Melee reward; At rank 7, claim Okinawan Tonfa as a Melee reward; At rank 7, claim Infiltrating Along the Mountain Path as a Starting Location reward; At rank 8, claim Restaurant as a Starting Location reward; At rank 9, claim Operating Theater Restroom as a Hidden Stash reward; At rank 10, claim Undercover in the Staff Quarters as a Starting Location reward; At rank 11, claim Kitchen Food Storage as a Agency Pickup reward; At rank 12, claim Concealable Knife as a Melee reward; At rank 12, claim Undercover in the Kitchen as a Starting Location reward; At rank 13, claim Garage as a Agency Pickup reward; At rank 14, claim Undercover in the Garden as a Starting Location reward; At rank 15, claim Explosive Compound as a Explosive reward; At rank 16, claim Morgue Storage as a Agency Pickup reward; At rank 17, claim Morgue as a Starting Location reward; At rank 18, claim Restaurant Restroom as a Hidden Stash reward; At rank 19, claim Undercover in the Operating Theater as a Starting Location reward; At rank 20, claim Escalation as a Striker reward; At rank 20, claim Challenge as a White Sunset Suit reward; At rank 20, claim Challenge as a Subject 47 reward; At rank 20, claim Challenge as a The Cherry Blossom Baller reward; At rank 20, claim Challenge as a VIP Patient reward; At rank 20, claim Challenge as a Polar Survival Suit reward; At rank 20, claim All Loadout Slots Available as a Unlock Loadout reward; At rank 20, claim HF Championship Bat as a Melee reward; At rank 20, claim Sieger 300 Advanced as a Sniper Rifle reward.

Destination Mastery

Mastery

HintReplays, discoveries, guided opportunities, and varied challenge methods all feed the same destination progression.
WhereRaise this destination's Mastery to rank 20; the Challenges tab supplies the XP needed for every gated reward.

Destination Mastery

Mastery

HintReplays, discoveries, guided opportunities, and varied challenge methods all feed the same destination progression.

Curated Featured Contracts Catalogue

Featured contract

HintThe curated contract browser contains authored routes beyond the campaign challenge lists.
WhereOpen Contracts, filter to Featured, and clear every finite entry currently visible on your platform that you want included in the profile audit.
Full detailFeatured batches remain online and the catalogue grows, so it has no permanent final count. Clear each currently visible contract through its results screen; the finite completion target is the last reward tier in both Featured Contract tracks, while later catalogue additions are ongoing optional play.

User-Created Contracts Scope

Scope rule

HintAn unlimited browser cannot form a finite save-file checklist.
WhereTreat player-made contracts outside the curated Featured list as optional and unbounded.
Full detailDo not attempt to clear the entire Contracts browser: players can publish new entries continuously. For finite completion, finish the developer Escalations, permanent Arcade trials, destination challenges, and both Featured Contract reward tracks; play other contracts only by choice.

Elusive Target Arcade

You are here when: The permanent Arcade tile in the game-mode menu, separate from the live Elusive Target panel.

Arcade trials are replayable after a failure cooldown. Paid celebrity trials require their corresponding content entitlement.

The Ellipses

Arcade trial

HintA permanent multi-stage trial reuses special assignments under a shared ruleset.
WhereWith access status 'included permanent Arcade catalogue', open Elusive Target Arcade, choose this trial, and clear its listed stages in order.
Full detailConfirm that the required entitlement is installed (included permanent Arcade catalogue), then read the stage briefing without launching until your loadout is ready. Complete each displayed objective and exit; continue through every stage. Apply the listed complication where required: Hide all Bodies (Optional). A failed stage restarts trial progress and applies a cooldown. Completion unlock shown by the source tracker: Krugermeier 2-2 Dark; +4000XP.

Arcade Reward Separation

Scope rule

HintPermanent Arcade trials and one-attempt live windows record different rewards.
WhereUse Arcade for its own permanent challenge and unlock catalogue; it does not substitute for normal live-window location or milestone rewards.
Full detailFinish each Arcade tile for its displayed unlock. If a suit or milestone specifically names ordinary Elusive Target completion, wait for a valid live rerun; clearing the same subject in Arcade will not advance that separate record.

Freelancer Safehouse

You are here when: The lakeside safehouse hub with planning screens, weapon walls, tool cases, and unlockable rooms.

Freelancer uses online autosaves and real loss rules. A local file copy cannot reliably reverse server progression, so the safest backup is equipment discipline before departure.

Freelancer Campaign Completion

Campaign

HintBuild a reliable wall of equipment and choose syndicates whose objectives suit your strongest destinations.
WhereFinish all four syndicates in one campaign, including each showdown, without failing an alerted territory.
Full detailChoose a syndicate type with manageable optional objectives, bring only gear you can afford to lose, identify showdown suspects from the listed tells, eliminate the leader, and exit. Repeat through all four syndicates. A failed showdown or alerted territory ends the campaign and removes carried gear plus Freelancer tools, so preserve rare wall weapons unless needed.

Hardcore Campaign Completion

Campaign

HintDo not enable the harder ruleset until the weapon walls and tool cases can support repeated mandatory objectives.
WhereActivate Hardcore Mode at the safehouse only after banking strong gear, then finish a full campaign while completing every mandatory prestige objective.
Full detailFill the weapon walls and tool cases first, choose the least risky prestige objective before each departure, and treat every territory as alerted. In a showdown, satisfy the prestige condition as well as the leader objective before exiting. Failure ends the campaign and causes the mode's stated inventory losses; return to normal mode only after the completion record registers.

Freelancer Mastery

Mastery

HintCampaign actions, objectives, couriers, safes, and challenge milestones steadily expand the safehouse.
WhereRaise Freelancer Mastery to rank 100 and inspect each newly opened safehouse room, capacity increase, and cosmetic slot.
Full detailFinish campaigns, prioritize feasible payout and prestige objectives, open safes, and collect courier Merces to maintain steady XP. Continue to rank 100; after each unlock banner, return to the safehouse and interact with every new room, furnishing slot, wardrobe option, gear-capacity increase, and weapon-wall position.

Safehouse Weapon Wall

Collection

HintBring recoverable weapons home instead of abandoning useful models at an exit.
WhereFill every weapon silhouette shown on the safehouse walls by extracting with missing firearms and melee weapons or buying them from suppliers.
Full detailBefore a mission, photograph or note empty silhouettes. In the territory, inspect supplier stock and carried weapons, take missing models, and physically exit while holding or packing them. A wall weapon survives at the safehouse only after a successful exit; losing a mission while carrying it removes it until reacquired.

Freelancer Tool Cases

Collection

HintSuppliers, reward crates, and successful returns gradually fill the disposable tool cases.
WhereCollect every Freelancer tool displayed in the safehouse cases; buy or select missing tools and return successfully.
Full detailCompare supplier stock and reward-crate choices against empty case slots, acquire a missing tool, then exit the territory safely. Tools are temporary campaign inventory: failing a campaign removes the case collection, so fill the cases for the completion record after establishing a stable run rather than treating them as permanent wall gear.

Freelancer Prestige Progression

Prestige

HintPrestige is endgame recycling; postpone it until every eligible wall slot is filled and you are ready to rebuild.
WhereFill the required weapon collection, then use the safehouse Prestige terminal and repeat until every finite prestige challenge tier has registered.
Full detailConfirm the wall requirement and finish any active campaign first. Activate Prestige only when prepared to surrender the eligible weapon collection, Freelancer tools, and Merces named by the confirmation screen. Rebuild through suppliers and successful exits, refill the wall, and repeat through the final tracked tier; never confirm while a valued run is still in progress.
